label: GPU
description: Optimise rendering latency and frame pacing for competitive play.

items.title: High priority renderer
items.summary: Forces Naraka.exe into high priority with reliable GPU scheduling.

items.title: Hardware accelerated GPU scheduling
items.summary: Enables hardware accelerated GPU scheduling and disables MPO flicker.
items.script:
reg add HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\GraphicsDrivers /v HwSchMode /t REG_DWORD /d 2 /f
reg add HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\GraphicsDrivers /v OverlayTestMode /t REG_DWORD /d 5 /f
items.revert:
reg add HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\GraphicsDrivers /v HwSchMode /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f
reg delete HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\GraphicsDrivers /v OverlayTestMode /f

items.title: Shader cache purge
items.summary: Clears DXCache and GLCache folders before stage play.
items.revert: No revert needed — caches rebuild automatically.

label: CPU
description: Reduce context switching and improve input thread responsiveness.

items.title: Unpark performance cores
items.summary: Disables core parking on plugged-in power plans.
items.script:
powercfg -setacvalueindex SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_PROCESSOR CPMINCORES 100
powercfg -setactive SCHEME_CURRENT
items.revert:
powercfg -setacvalueindex SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_PROCESSOR CPMINCORES 10
powercfg -setactive SCHEME_CURRENT

items.title: Game mode essentials
items.summary: Keeps Windows Game Mode enabled but disables DVR and captures.
items.script:
reg add HKCU\System\GameConfigStore /v GameDVR_FSEBehaviorMode /t REG_DWORD /d 2 /f
reg add HKCU\System\GameConfigStore /v GameDVR_FSEBehavior /t REG_DWORD /d 2 /f
reg add HKCU\System\GameConfigStore /v GameDVR_Enabled /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f
items.revert:
reg delete HKCU\System\GameConfigStore /v GameDVR_FSEBehaviorMode /f
reg delete HKCU\System\GameConfigStore /v GameDVR_FSEBehavior /f
reg add HKCU\System\GameConfigStore /v GameDVR_Enabled /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f

label: OS
description: Trim background noise and apply Naraka specific shell tweaks.

items.title: Disable extraneous services
items.summary: Turns off SysMain and DiagTrack for consistent frametimes.
items.script:
sc stop SysMain
sc config SysMain start= disabled
sc stop DiagTrack
sc config DiagTrack start= disabled
items.revert:
sc config SysMain start= auto
sc start SysMain
sc config DiagTrack start= demand

items.title: Minimal desktop composition
items.summary: Applies dark high-contrast theme, disables animations, and sets focus visuals.
items.script:
reg add HKCU\Control Panel\Desktop /v DragFullWindows /t REG_SZ /d 0 /f
reg add HKCU\Control Panel\Desktop /v UserPreferencesMask /t REG_BINARY /d 9001008010000000 /f
items.revert: reg add HKCU\Control Panel\Desktop /v DragFullWindows /t REG_SZ /d 1 /f

label: Network
description: Stabilise packet delivery for EGL scrims and tournament hosting.

items.title: Optimised MTU
items.summary: Sets adapter MTU to 1480 and disables ECN for scrim environments.
items.script:
netsh interface ipv4 set subinterface "Ethernet" mtu=1480 store=persistent
netsh interface tcp set global ecncapability=disabled
items.revert:
netsh interface ipv4 set subinterface "Ethernet" mtu=1500 store=persistent
netsh interface tcp set global ecncapability=default

items.title: Naraka QoS prioritisation
items.summary: Tags Naraka.exe outbound traffic with DSCP 46 and disables Nagle's algorithm.
items.script:
reg add HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Psched /v NonBestEffortLimit /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f
reg add HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip\Parameters /v TcpNoDelay /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f
items.revert:
reg delete HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Psched /v NonBestEffortLimit /f
reg delete HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip\Parameters /v TcpNoDelay /f
